title: Hyppolita
summary: Raleigh names Hyppolita in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hyppolita, Queene of the Amazons, taken by Theseus, on whom he begat Hippolytus. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. VII, sig. 271a
